outline:
本課程之目標為增進研究生之英文閱讀能力與寫作技巧，介紹英文科技論文的慣用語法、用字與閱讀技巧及分析撰寫英文報告與學術論文之章法與組織要領。
The object of this course is to improve reading ability and writing skill for graduate students. This course introduces grammar, terms and phrases that are frequently used in English technical articles. Structures of English essay and thesis will also be explained.
schedule:
W1~4 Training in Scientific English Writing and Editing(科技英文撰寫與編修訓練)
W5~7 Structure of Scientific Papers(科技論文架構與撰寫要領)
W8~9 Utilization of Library Resources: Scopus & WOS Journal Database Searches, SciVal Research Assessment Analysis System (圖書館資源利用 Scopus & WOS 期刊資料庫查詢，SciVal研究評估分析系統)
W10 Key Points for Journal paper Submission: Collection and Sharing of Author Instructions from Major Journals in the Field, Journal Manuscript Practice (Following Journal Formats), Writing a Cover Letter期刊論文投稿要點，領域重要期刊author instruction蒐集分享、期刊manuscript實作練習(依期刊格式)、撰寫Cover letter
W11-12  Professional Paper Editing (專業論文潤稿): Dr. Wallace team lectures
W13~16 Practical Exercises and Sharing in Scientific Paper Writing (科技論文實作練習與分享): 論文標題訂定、撰寫Abstract、Introduction、Methods、Results、Discussion、Conclusions、Recommendations for Future Studies、Reference

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
flexible_learning.content:
本課程彈性學習週以學生自主論文撰寫與同儕互評為核心，學生依據課程所學之科技論文架構、學術英文撰寫及期刊投稿規範，完成論文全文修訂，並透過同儕互評機制針對摘要、研究方法、結果討論及學術英文表達進行交流與建議。學生將依據同儕及教師回饋持續修正論文內容，提升論文邏輯性、學術寫作品質及國際期刊投稿能力，培養自主學習及學術溝通能力。

Week 17: Flexible Learning: Scientific Paper Revision and Peer Review
Week 18: Flexible Learning: Journal Manuscript Refinement and Submission Preparation
flexible_learning.outcome: 學生須完成一份符合目標期刊格式之完整論文（或指定章節），並繳交修訂紀錄及同儕互評回饋表。教師將依據論文架構完整性、學術英文品質、投稿格式符合度及學生修訂歷程進行評量，以檢視學生科技論文寫作能力及自主學習成效。

assessment:
實作練習Practical Exercises (含Oral presentation) 50%
Attendance and Class Participation 出席與上課表現40%
Flexible Learning (Week 17-18): 10%
